profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Peraton
profile.summary:
Mike is a highly experienced Data Warehouse Architect and Systems Integrator. He is fully qualified in Data Warehouse and OLTP system designs. Mike has been an active participant on numerous teams, which include leadership and mentoring responsibilities, and he is also adept at self-directing and taking ownership of given tasks. Skills include:

•	Databases –SQL Server, Oracle, OpenEdge, Netezza, Sybase, Access, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
•	Data movement and transformation tools – Pentaho Data Integration, Microsoft SSIS, Informatica PowerCenter.
•	Languages – TransactSQL, PL/SQL, JavaScript, Java, C, C++, C#, VB, UNIX & Windows Shell Scripting.
•	Database modeling tools – CA ERwin, Oracle Data Modeler, Sybase PowerDesigner.
•	Reporting tools – QlikView, Logi, Cognos, Crystal, and Microsoft Access.
•	Additional Experience – Agile Development, Health IT, HL7 standard, XML, JSON.

Specialties: Certified QlikView 11 Developer & Server Administrator, ETL, SQL, Database Administration, OpenEdge, Sybase, Oracle, SQL Server, C, UNIX, Java, Data Warehouse, Data Modeling, Dimensional Modeling, Architect, Developer

positions.description: Peraton acquired the Federal IT and Mission Support Services business of Northrop Grumman

positions.title: Senior Data Warehouse Engineer
positions.description:
BravePoint was acquired by Progress Software on October 1st, 2014.

Developing Business Intelligence products for customers.

positions.title: Senior Data Warehouse Consultant
positions.description:
BravePoint was acquired by Progress Software on October 1st, 2014.

Assisting clients with their Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, Data Integration, and Enterprise Reporting projects. This includes support of all aspects of the software development life-cycle including but not limited to gathering business requirements, automating processes, designing data models, and developing solutions to meet business intelligence, reporting, automation, and integration needs.

positions.title: Data Warehouse Architect
positions.description:
Architect and Developer on the CDC project “BioSense” which received large daily feeds from health care organizations including VA & DoD clinical facilities, LabCorp & Quest laboratories, and large hospital systems. Source formats included flat-files, HL7, and XML and included real-time messages and daily batch feeds. Project utilized SQL Server, Oracle, Informatica PowerCenter RT, and BEA’s WebLogic and JBOSS JMS, along with custom written C++ functions. System was implemented in both a Windows and SUN UNIX environments.

Architect and Developer on the CDC project “Common Data Store” which received case notification
messages of notifiable conditions from state public health departments in several source formats including NETSS, HL7 and XML and delivers output through marts and feeds in a uniformed, standardized format, both in structure and content. Project utilized SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, dynamic SQL, and custom written C# SQL Server CLR functions in a Windows environment.

positions.title: Senior Data Warehouse Developer
positions.description: Architected, implemented, and maintained Cendian’s Business Intelligence (BI) environment.  The BI environment resided on several Windows 2000 Servers with databases in SQL Server 2000.  Sources consisted of several Oracle and SQL Server databases and flat-files.  Extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) done primarily with Informatica PowerCenter and with custom dynamic stored procedures (which won a runner up 2004 Innovator Award by SQL Server Magazine seen in January 2005 issue).  Reporting environment was made up of Cognos’ reporting suite that included Impromptu / IWR, PowerPlay / PPES, and Architect (certified on all products).  Tasks also included installation, upgrading, and administration of both the ETL and reporting environments, which also included customization to Cognos’ upfront intranet portal and custom automated report execution and email distribution using CognosScript.

positions.title: Senior Data Warehouse Developer
positions.description:
While a full-time telecommuter, responsible for the development of BellSouth Internet Services’ data
warehouse system plus several heterogeneous data integration projects utilizing SUN, Informatica,
Sybase, Oracle, flat-files, email and web reports. Data Warehouse Administrator of the ETL environment, which included deploying ETL code into production, providing 24x7 on-call support, and ongoing monitoring and tuning of the environment.
